title: NAFEMS 5R: converged Hex20 random displacement, remaining known failure
source: NAFEMS, Selected Benchmarks for Forced Vibration, R0016, 1989, Test 5R

quantities.reason: 1% predeclared public-reference target, tighter than the observed ~1.68% remaining model discrepancy; do not widen to bless.
quantities.known_failure: Hex20 converged displacement peak remains ~1.68% below the published beam value; continuum end-face supports, single-node axial locator and 16-mode truncation remain limitations.

quantities.reason: 0.2% allowance for public frequency rounding, damped peak and finite frequency sampling; not a displacement acceptance.
